subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate title for the given passage.
solution:
The correct answer is Social Media and Mental Health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Refer to the beginning of the passage: 'Humans are social animals by nature. To prosper in life, we require the company of others, and the strength of our bonds has a significant influence on our **mental health** and happiness'.
 
• Refer to the concluding line of the passage: 'The more you're rewarded, the more time you want to spend on social media, even if it has negative consequences in other areas of your life'.
 
• In the whole passage the writer is talking about social media and its effect on one's mental health.
 
• Hence, 'social media and mental health' is the most **appropriate title** for the given passage.
 
• Thus, option 3 is the correct answer
